prompt:
Subject: Menstrual care during a monthly period.

Composition: Show an adult seated comfortably beside a bathroom cabinet, holding a wrapped menstrual pad while an opened plain pad package rests on the shelf. A warm-water bottle sits nearby; keep the person fully clothed and the scene ordinary, non-graphic, and free of medical instructions.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. No text, speech balloons, explanatory captions, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
en: A fully clothed adult sits comfortably by a bathroom cabinet holding a wrapped menstrual pad, with a warm-water bottle nearby.
ja: 服を着た大人が浴室の棚のそばで生理用品を手に持ち、近くに湯たんぽが置かれている。
